definitions.gloss: to arise; to break out; to be stirred up
definitions.explanation: For something like controversy, emotion, or phenomena to suddenly arise or develop with momentum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こった。
⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こった。
examples.english: A big round of applause erupted.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こった。
examples.english: That statement sparked a huge debate.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こった。
examples.english: A storm of criticism arose online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客席|かんきゃくせき}→観客席：07139_kankyakuseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}→拍手喝采：14977_hakushukassai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こり、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{興奮|こうふん}→興奮：02751_koufun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: Applause and cheers erupted from the audience, and the venue was filled with excitement.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive. The reaction is the subject and arises on its own; nobody {巻|ま}き{起|お}こる anything.
- The transitive partner ⟦{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす→巻き起こす：30744_makiokosu⟧ means to stir something up deliberately.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる (debate breaks out)
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる (criticism erupts)
- ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる (applause breaks out)

REGISTER:
What {巻|ま}き{起|お}こる is almost always a reaction that spreads through a crowd or a society — debate, criticism, applause, a craze. A single small event simply ⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧. The compound is built from ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind, to roll) plus ⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧, and keeps the image of something rolling outward as it arises; it is common in news writing.
